description: Variation of Condition 2 (Approved Plans) regarding planning application 01054/379-389/P1 (P/2019/3935) dated 07/05/2022 for the erection of one five storey building and one four storey building to create 64 flats with car and cycle parking, waste and recycling storage and associated works
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from 27/05/2022.
Reason: To accord with provisions of section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990. 
Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Drainage Assessment v1.0 28 May 2021; received 31/08/2021, STA2-PB-04B, STA2-PB-06B, STA2-PB-07B, STA2-PA-06B, STA2-PA-08B, STA2-PA-09B, STA2-PA-14B,STA2-PA-15B; received 19/05/2021, 
Design and Access Statement, Travel Plan February 2021, Arboricultural report 23rd February 2021, Transport Assessment February 2021, Written Scheme of Investigation for an Archaeological Evaluation November 2020 revised February 2021, SuDSmart Pro ref 72056R4, 2021-02-23, Daylight & Sunlight Assessment 24 February 2021, Energy Statement Issue 2.0 19 February 2021; received 25/02/2021 
Air Quality Assessment October 2019, Site investigation report (Report Reference C14281A, dated Nov. 2019, Code for Sustainable Homes Compliant Ecological Assessment November 2014, Assessment of External Noise ref140508- 002A November 2014; received: 15/11/2019
STB2-S73-01, STB2-S73-02, STB2-S73-03, STA2-S73-01, STA2-S73-02, STA2-S73-03, STA2-S73-04, STA2-S73-05, STA2-S73-11, STA2-S73-12, statement of changes received: 10/03/2024
Brick specification 1, brick specification 2 received: 18/05/2024
Transport assessment received: 28/05/2024
STB2-S73-05F received: 02/07/2024
Transport addendum received: 07/08/2024
Part L1 Design Stage SAP Calculations. Prepared by ERS Consultants Ltd. Received: 13/09/2024
Carbon Offset Calculation Report. Prepared by ERS Consultants Ltd. Received: 13/09/2024
Basic compliance report calculation type new build (as designed). Prepared by Design SAP Elmhurst energy. Received: 13/09/2024
20/0707 REV C. Received: 19/11/2024
Landscape management plan. Received: 20/11/2024) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used. 

Reason: To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permi
Condition : 3 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of materials approved on 14/02/2023 under P/2022/3187  and the substitute brick information; Brick specification 1 & brick specification 2 received: 18/05/2024
The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the approved details.

Reason: In order that the Council may be satisfied as to the details of the development; in accordance with Local Plan policy CC2. 
Condition : 4 - A) No development (except any demolition, site clearance, ground investigation and remediation work) shall take place until a finalised Energy Strategy (demonstrating how the targets for carbon dioxide emissions reduction are to be met in line with the Mayor's energy hierarchy) has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.

B) Prior to first occupation of the building(s) evidence (e.g. photographs, installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the Standard Assessment Procedure) should be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy, and any subsequent approved revisions. 

Reason: To ensure that the development makes the fullest contribution to minimising carbon dioxide emissions in accordance with London Plan Policy S12 and the London Borough of Hounslow Local Plan Policy EQ1.
Condition : 5 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details approved on 29/10/2024 under P/2024/2993 and P/2024/4206 approved on 09/01/2025.

The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the approved details.

Reason: In order to protect and conserve water supplies and resources in accordance with London Plan Policy S12 and the London Borough of Hounslow Local Plan Policy EQ2.
Condition : 6 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details approved on 14/02/2023 under P/2022/3187 and P/2024/3994 approved on 14/01/2025.

The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the approved details.

Reason: In order to ensure the sustainable sourcing of materials in accordance with the London Plan Policy S13 and the Mayor of London's Sustainable Design and Construction SPG.
Condition : 7 - Prior to the first occupation of the hereby approved development the proposed play space as shown on the submitted plans shall be fully implemented and ready for use and shall be thereafter retained as such without obstruction for the duration of the development. 

Reason: To ensure that adequate play space is provided in line with the London Plan policy D4 and the Mayors SPG - Providing for children and young people's play and informal recreation.
Condition : 8 - During the course of the development: 

A)	The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details approved on 29/10/2024 under P/2024/2994.  

B)	The agreed scheme for decontamination referred to in clauses b) and c) above, including amendments, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval. 

Reason: Contamination is known or suspected on the site due to a former land use. The LPA therefore wishes to ensure that the development can be implemented and occupied with adequate regard for public and environmental safety. 

Supporting notes: 
a. An initial phase 1 desk study and a Phase 2 intrusive investigation have been submitted with the original application and is considered satisfactory. 
b. In some instances the LPA may require work on site to be ceased whilst the nature of additional contamination is investigated fully. 
c. The validation report shall revisit the site conceptual model/additional works identified, and provide evidence that each aspect of the decontamination scheme was carried out correctly and successfully. This report shall prove that the development is suitable for its new use. 
d. We request that site investigation reports or site plans be sent electronically to landquality@hounslow.gov.uk or by post on a cd or dvd wherever possible.
Condition : 9 - The hereby approved development shall be carried out in strict accordance with the mitigation measures recommended in the submitted Noise Impact Assessment report and the building shall be constructed so as to provide sound insulation against externally generated noise of not less than the standards outlined in BS8233:2014 with windows shut and other means of ventilation provided. The sound insulation works shall be completed before the building is first occupied or brought into use and retained thereafter. 

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of future residential properties; in accordance with Local Plan policies CC2 & EQ5.
Condition : 10 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm on Mondays to Friday and 9am to 1pm on Saturdays and not at all on Sundays and Public Holidays. 

Reason: In order to safeguard the amenities of adjoining residents and the amenities of the locality in accordance with Local Plan policies CC1, CC2 and EQ5 and Policies 7.15 (Reducing noise and enhancing soundscapes) and the London Plan policy S13.
Condition : 11 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the construction logistics plan approved on 14/02/2023 under P/2022/3187. 

The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the approved details.

Reason: To ensure highway safety is maintained and preserved in accordance with policy EC2 of the Local Plan.
Condition : 12 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of privacy screening approved on 23/09/2022 under P/2022/2272.

The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the approved details.

Reason: In the interest of biodiversity, sustainability, and to ensure that a satisfactory standard of visual amenity is provided and maintained in accordance with policies CC1 and CC2 of the adopted Local Plan.
Condition : 13 - The hard and soft landscaping shall be in accordance with the landscape management plan received: 20/11/2024 and drawing number 20/0707 REV C received: 19/11/2024 and thereafter maintained for the lifetime of the development 

Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance of the site and the adjacent the area in accordance with Local Plan policies CC1, CC2 and GB7.

Condition : 14 - The cycle stores shall be in accordance with the details of cycle storage approved on 15/04/2025 under P/2024/4093 and thereafter maintained for the lifetime of the development.

The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the approved details.

Reason: In accordance with policy T5 of the London Plan and Local Plan policy EC2. 

Condition : 15 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of drainage design approved on 30/11/2022 under P/2022/2824.

The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the approved details.

Reason: To demonstrate that surface water runoff will be managed for the lifetime of the development in line with, amongst others, the relevant London Plan policies and Non-Technical Standards for Sustainable Drainage Systems requirements.

Condition : 16 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of drainage approved on 15/04/2025 under P/2025/0022.

The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the approved details.

Reason: To ensure that the methods to mitigate the risk of surface water flooding have been constructed as agreed and that the drainage system is suitably managed.
Condition : 17 - A minimum of six Wheelchair User Dwellings, built to Building Regulations M4(3) standards, shall be provided in accordance with the approved plans. These units shall be retained as such for the duration of the development. 

Reason: To ensure a socially inclusive and sustainable development in accordance with Local Plan Policy SC3 and policies D4 (Housing quality and standards) and D5 (Accessible housing) of the London Plan.
Condition : 18 - Prior to the occupation of the hereby approved development the parking spaces as shown on the submitted plans shall be made available for use and shall be maintained as such for the duration of the development without obstruction. 

Reason: To ensure parking is provided in line with Local Plan policy EC2 (Developing a sustainable local transport network) and Policy T6.1 (Residential Parking) of the London Plan.
Condition : 19 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of the written scheme of investigation approved on 25/08/2022 under P/2022/2176. 

Reason: To safeguard the archaeological interest on this site.
Condition : 20 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the mitigation measures proposed in the submitted Air Quality Assessment during construction and operational phases. 

Reason: To ensure that there is no adverse impact on air quality in accordance with policy EQ4 (Air quality) of the Local Plan.
Condition : 21 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of the parking management plan approved on 03/04/2025 under P/2025/0023. 

The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the approved details.

Reason: To control the level and usage of parking on the site and to support sustainable transport objectives; in accordance with Local Plan policy EC2.
Condition : 22 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of Secure by Design approved on 26/03/2025 under P/2025/0547. 

The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the approved details.

Reason: In pursuance of the Council's duty under section 17 of the Crime and Disorder Act 1998 to consider crime and disorder implications in excising its planning functions; to promote the well-being of the area in pursuance of the Council's powers under section 2 of the Local Government Act 2000 and to ensure the development provides a safe and secure environment in accordance with London Plan (July 2011) Policies 7.1 and 7.3.
Condition : 23 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of the boundary treatment approved on 14/02/2023 under P/2022/3187. 

The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the approved details.

Reason: To safeguard the visual amenities of the locality and privacy of adjoining properties in accordance with policies CC1 and CC2 of the adopted Local Plan.
Condition : 24 - Notwithstanding the details shown on the approved drawings full details of the proposed vehicular and pedestrian access to the site shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of development above ground level. No other part of the development shall begin until the new means of access has been sited, laid out and constructed in accordance with the approved details. 

Reason: In order to minimise danger, obstruction and inconvenience to users of the highway and of the access in accordance with adopted Local Plan Policy EC2.
Condition : 25 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of the delivery and servicing plan approved on 15/04/2025 under P/2025/0545. 

The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the approved details.

Reason: In the interests of road safety, in accordance with Hounslow Local Plan Policy EC2.
Condition : 26 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of the waste and recycling approved on 22/04/2025 under P/2025/0070. 

The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the approved details.

Reason: To ensure that refuse can be properly stored and removed from the site as soon as the building is occupied in accordance with Local Plan Policies CC1, CC2 and EQ7. Details required prior to commencement of development to ensure the development is compliant with the Development Plan.
